points.description: Names one membrane transport process (e.g. selective permeability, passive transport, osmosis, facilitated diffusion, active transport, pumps, membrane-assisted transport such as exocytosis/endocytosis/phagocytosis/pinocytosis, or protein channels) and gives an accurate description of how it moves substances across the membrane.
Names a second, different process from the same range and gives an accurate description of how it moves substances across the membrane.
Names a third, different process from the same range and gives an accurate description of how it moves substances across the membrane.

rubric.notes: Full marks require three different processes, each correctly named and accurately described; equivalent wording and correct alternative processes earn the marks. A process that is named but not described, or described incorrectly, does not earn its mark. Fewer than three valid processes earn marks only for the valid ones.
